comments: Stability fix for kuralsnet_npu_seg_8x64_cfar_damp_kernel3_finetune_dropout.json (0.3749/0.3529 val/test, a near-tie with plain max-pool's 0.3757/0.3635 but with a real train-loss instability spike, 0.003-0.06 -> 1.1-1.9, right around epoch 206-208 -- just past quant_freeze_iters=60000's default epoch~174). Two changes: (1) quant_warmup_iters/quant_freeze_iters extended 15000/60000 -> 40000/75000 (matching kuralsnet_npu_seg_wide96.json's precedent for a different hard-to-calibrate scenario) -- gives the QAT observers more time to calibrate to the CFAR-damped data's extreme bimodal distribution (background flattened to one constant, rare sharp spikes) before freezing; (2) grad_clip_norm=1.0, new kurals/learners/model.py param (torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_ before optimizer.step(), defaults to None/off for every other config) as a low-risk safety net regardless of root cause. Same architecture/init/data otherwise.
